review_notes: Reviewed all of TaylorCoeff.lean (lines 1–245), Mathlib's dslope definition and iterate identity in Analysis/Calculus/DSlope.lean, the power-series bridge in Analysis/Analytic/IsolatedZeros.lean, and Mathlib's taylorCoeffWithin in Analysis/Calculus/Taylor.lean. The latter is a real-valued, within-set derivative-based API, not an avoidable competing version of this complex-analytic germ extractor. The target's extractor is used by the residue-calculus sources, and the exact remainder theorem is not the same result as Mathlib's derivative-based remainder theorems. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
